verdict.rationale: The evidence only gestures at this story. Sentry documents 'Billing Quota Management' and lists 'Advanced quota management' on its pricing page, which relates to controlling event volume. It also has an 'Issue Status' triage page and an 'Alerts' page, but all of these are bare titles with no content describing spike protection, per-key rate limits, or mute/ignore rules. Missing for 10: explicit spike-protection documentation, per-DSN/key rate-limit configuration, documented mute/ignore/snooze rules for alerts or issues, and any independent or hands-on corroboration of reducing alert noise.
